# Fettle London

> Fettle London is a small, permanent handyman and home maintenance team looking after London homes since 2023. One team for the whole house: painting and decorating, plastering, plumbing (no gas or boiler work), lighting and socket installation (by a certified electrician), carpet cleaning and carpet fitting, end of tenancy cleaning, flooring, tiling, fencing and gates, gardening, small tree surgery, moving help, and odd jobs. Covers north, northwest, west, southwest (including Wimbledon), south, east and central London, plus Kingston and Sutton. No travel charge anywhere it covers, and no Congestion Charge passed on. Open Monday to Saturday, 8am–9pm. Phone and WhatsApp: +44 7361 854124. Email: hello@fettlelondon.com. Instagram: @fettlelondon. Facebook: Fettle London.

Pricing: a free 10-minute video call to see the job and quote (book at https://calendar.app.google/XKzAocmeAU5WH2as6). If an in-person visit is needed it is £30, taken off the job when you go ahead. Half-day from £140, full day from £260, materials at cost. Carpet cleaning from £45 per room. End of tenancy cleaning from £180 (studio). No travel charge or other extras; homes more than about 9 miles from Chelsea are booked as half-days or longer. Small electrical jobs (lights, sockets) are the exception and are always priced on their own.

## Services

- [Handyman services](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/handyman): shelves, TV mounting, flat-pack, doors, locks and small repairs
- [Painting and decorating](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/painting-decorating): walls, ceilings, woodwork, hallways and period rooms
- [Plastering](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/plastering): cracks, patch plastering, skimming and making good
- [Plumbing](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/plumbing): taps, toilets, leaks, radiators and appliance plumbing
- [End of tenancy cleaning](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/end-of-tenancy-cleaning): deep clean, carpets, small repairs, 48-hour re-clean guarantee
- [Carpet cleaning](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/carpet-cleaning): deep clean, stain treatment, stairs and rugs
- [Fencing and gates](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/fences-gardens)
- [Gardening](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/gardening)
- [Small tree surgery](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/tree-surgery)
- [Moving help](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/moving-help)
- [Lighting and sockets](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/electrical)
- [Carpet fitting](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/carpet-fitting)
- [Tiling](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/tiling)
- [Flooring](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/flooring-tiling)
- [Home maintenance](https://www.fettlelondon.com/services/home-maintenance): gutters, damp checks, seasonal look-overs

## Membership – In Fine Fettle

- [Home maintenance membership](https://www.fettlelondon.com/membership): scheduled home maintenance plans in London from the same small team. Spring & Autumn (2 visits a year) from £29/month, Every Season (4 visits a year) from £59/month, Every Month (12 visits a year) from £129/month. Each full visit includes a 14-point home check (gutters, seals, damp, leaks, radiators, alarms and more), with a written note afterwards.
